notes.content: computer science - CSU Northridge General Education

Engineering and Computer Science majors may follow CSU Northridge GE Plan instead of Cal-GETC. Computer Science students are required to take courses in the following CSU GE areas: CSU Northridge GE English Composition - Written Communication (3 units) = CSU GE Area 1A Oral Communication (3 units) = CSU GE Area 1C Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning (3 units) = CSU GE Area 2 Arts (3 units) = CSU GE Area 3A Humanities (3 units) = CSU GE Area 3B Social and Behavioral Sciences (3 units) = CSU GE Area 4 Ethnic Studies (3 units) = CSU GE Area 6 CSUN Section F - Comparative Cultural Studies (3 units) U.S. History and Government (6 units) = CSU US History, Constitution, and American Ideals All other General Education requirements are met through completion of courses in the major. Students applying to majors in the College of Engineering and Computer Science do not need CSU GE-Critical Thinking 1B prior to admission.
notes.contentHtml:
Engineering and Computer Science majors may follow CSU Northridge GE Plan instead of Cal-GETC.


Computer Science students are required to take courses in the following CSU GE areas: CSU Northridge GE

  • English Composition - Written Communication (3 units) = CSU GE Area 1A
  • Oral Communication (3 units) = CSU GE Area 1C
  • Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning (3 units) = CSU GE Area 2
  • Arts (3 units) = CSU GE Area 3A
  • Humanities (3 units) = CSU GE Area 3B
  • Social and Behavioral Sciences (3 units) = CSU GE Area 4
  • Ethnic Studies (3 units) = CSU GE Area 6
  • CSUN Section F - Comparative Cultural Studies (3 units)
  • U.S. History and Government (6 units) = CSU US History, Constitution, and American Ideals


All other General Education requirements are met through completion of courses in the major. Students applying to majors in the College of Engineering and Computer Science do not need CSU GE-Critical Thinking 1B prior to admission.
